Adam Levine and Behati Prinsloo’s high-profile marriage has long attracted attention, especially following Levine’s 2022 cheating scandal. Years after the incident, he has praised his wife’s appearance at the Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show.
 Adam Levine praises Behati Prinsloo’s Victoria’s Secret appearance years after his 2022 messaging scandal
 On Sunday, October 18, Namibian model Behati Prinsloo walked the runway at the 2026 Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show. Levine celebrated his wife’s return to the runway with a heartfelt Instagram post.
 Levine posted his wife’s photo on Instagram, and wrote, “totally and completely and eternally blown away.”
 Advertisement
 In the photo, the model appears seated in a backstage dressing area. She looks glamorous and stylish. The 38-year-old tilts her head slightly to one side and looks toward the camera with a serious yet confident expression. Prinsloo’s long, golden-brown hair falls below her shoulders. Behati Prinsloo wears a black sleeveless dress with a lace design. She pairs it with a delicate chain necklace and a small pendant. She sits at a slight angle on a white chair, striking a pose for the camera. Large mirrors, makeup supplies, lights, and chairs fill the background.
 For context, Maroon 5 singer’s cheating scandal came to light in September 2022. The controversy reportedly strained his relationship with Behati Prinsloo. However, they stayed together and remain a couple. That month, Instagram model Sumner Stroh shared a video on TikTok claiming she had an affair with Levine for nearly a year.
 Adam Levine also allegedly messaged Stroh about naming his unborn child “Summer.” At the time, Prinsloo was pregnant with their third child. He later issued a public apology on social media. The singer denied having a physical affair but admitted that he had crossed a line by communicating with someone other than his wife.
 The post Adam Levine Reacts to Wife’s Victoria’s Secret Show Years After Cheating Scandal appeared first on Mandatory .
